map.名义年利率按复利次数折算的真实年化收益率。: The true annualized return of a nominal annual rate converted by compounding frequency.
map.EAR=(1+r/n)^n−1，r 名义年利率、n 复利次数，是贷款的真实年化成: EAR=(1+r/n)^n−1, with r the nominal annual rate and n the compounding frequency; it is the true annualized cost of a loan. Compare credit products by EAR, not the contractual APR; high-frequency compounding significantly raises the cost.
map.n 越大 EAR 越接近连续复利。: Larger n makes EAR closer to continuous compounding.
map.把「名义年利率+按月计息」的贷款折算成真实年化成本。: Convert a loan with 'nominal annual rate + monthly compounding' into its true annualized cost.
map.比较不同复利频率的信贷产品真实利率。: Compare the true rates of credit products at different compounding frequencies.
map.识别「低名义利率但高频复利」的隐性成本。: Identify the hidden cost of 'low nominal rate but high-frequency compounding'.
map.名义 12%、按月复利的有效年利率: Effective annual rate at nominal 12%, monthly compounding
map.EAR=(1+0.12/12)^12−1=1.01^12−1≈0.12683=1: EAR=(1+0.12/12)^12−1=1.01^12−1≈0.12683=12.683%. Monthly compounding makes the true cost 0.683 percentage points above the nominal 12%.
map.EAR 和 APR 一样吗？: Is EAR the same as APR?
map.不一样。APR（年百分率）通常只体现名义利率、不反映复利频率；EAR 把复利频率: No. APR (annual percentage rate) usually shows only the nominal rate and ignores compounding frequency; EAR includes it and is the true annualized cost. Compare loans by EAR.
map.为什么信用卡用 EAR 表述？: Why is EAR used for credit cards?
map.信用卡日利率（如 0.05%/天）若直接×365 会低估，因为存在每日滚复。折算: A credit-card daily rate (e.g. 0.05%/day) underestimates if simply ×365 because of daily compounding. Converting to EAR enables fair comparison with annualized products, about 19.56%.
